Risk: Misaligned assistance due to uncertain user goals in shared autonomy
Problem analysis: Cluttered environments reduce single goal prediction accuracy
Theoretical insight: POMDP formulation with uncertain goals enables distributional assistance
Design rationale: Assisting for entire goal distribution reduces required prediction confidence
Implementation mechanism: POMDP assistance action computed via QMDP gradient following
Validation evidence: User study showing faster task completion and reduced input with distributional assistance
Intervention: Implement Hindsight Optimization action selection in shared autonomy controllers
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.07619
